Rule: One value per cell; a key for every row
What breaks it: A list in a cell; columns product1, product2, product3

Rule: First, and every non-key column depends on the whole key
What breaks it: A partial dependency (possible only with a composite key)
Repair: The part of the key and its columns move to their own table

Rule: Second, and no non-key column depends on another non-key column
Repair: The determinant and its columns move to their own table
